_about: Review-timing context for the US and the EU, from two separate registered sources. The two are different statistics (US: medians and percentages; EU: averages in days) and are NEVER combined, compared, subtracted or averaged. Every value carries the registered passage id it was read from; a test checks each value against that passage text.

us.source_id: FDA PDUFA Performance Report to Congress, FY 2025 (preliminary)
us.statistic: percentages and counts of goals; medians exist only in Figure 2 as chart values and are not registered

first_cycle_approval_percent.cohort: applications filed in FY 2024 and approved in the first review cycle

us.median_months_to_approval: [GAP] recent-year medians appear only in the Figure 2 chart of the report; chart values are not registered and are not used

median_note.text: FY2023 standard median was higher in part because more applications had NME goals with 3-month extensions

goals.basis: from the 60-day filing date; goals, not durations

total_average_days.definition: start of the evaluation to the European Commission decision, positive opinions

commission_decision_days.basis: from receipt of the CHMP opinion

never_combine: EMA averages and FDA medians are different statistics on different populations; no combined figure is produced anywhere in this skill.
